rationale: Every supplied artifact use of claim C-CHAL-006 consistently preserves its scope and limitations. The artifacts accurately describe AMLAS as a public, six-stage ML-component methodology, explicitly noting its limitations to the ML component, its need for complementary system/domain assurance, and its primary focus on offline supervised learning. No instances of omitted qualifications, changed status, or inferences presented as authority evidence were found. The artifacts even proactively clarify potential misinterpretations of AMLAS's role, reinforcing its stated boundaries.
